text: On the 192-core host with /data/genomes/hg38.fa, sufr create -d -a -n 2000 -t 32 on hg38 at 163d48d took 172.5 s and 177 s with the N-run shortcut in `find_lcp` and 121 s and 136 s without it. With -i added it took 445 s against 357 s. The cost was two binary searches over hg38's 488 runs of 1,000 or more N on every `find_lcp` call. 9433918 removed the shortcut on dev. Measured 2026-11-09.
